entry.title: El coste de contexto por tarea es una constante del instrumento, no del tamano del corpus
entry.summary: En tres generaciones del panel, la poblacion crecio 1.90x y el total de tokens por tarea 3.08x, mientras la fraccion de tokens que se reenvia antes de producir la primera palabra se movio 0.1145 puntos porcentuales (99.2146 -> 99.2755 -> 99.1610 %) y el cociente entre tokens totales y llamadas al modelo se movio 0.018 %. La cifra absoluta responde al tamano del corpus; la razon responde al instrumento. Publicar el total como si midiera una tendencia mide el corpus, no el coste.

entry.title: The $6.3B hack was not a code bug
entry.summary: Ten public repositories with a deployment workflow, measured with the exact commit of each one: 807 findings and 115 with a conjunction of authority. None of the ten returns a clean green, and the article says why that is not 807 vulnerabilities.

entry.title: Context economics — the 99.2 %
entry.summary: 99.2 % of an agent's cost is input, not output. Measured across two generations of the same panel: the total moves 28.19 % between runs, the ratio moves 0.06 points. That is why what is sold is a ratio and not a receipt.

entry.title: I swept 50 repositories: two real defects and a 2 % hit rate
entry.summary: I measured 765 workflow files in 50 repos with more than 5 000 stars: 262 steps invoke a test runner and 11 cannot make the workflow fail. The defensible-defect rate is 2 %, and the most severe one sits in the deadest repository.

entry.title: The bug that answers SUCCESS: a reproducible audit of litellm#46923
entry.summary: Six arms, an HTTP server that records the real payload and a negative control. How to audit a framework defect without mocks, why the candidate patch makes the synchronous path worse, and why the dangerous state is the one that looks like success.

entry.title: El paso que corre los tests del shard sale en verde cuando no corre ningun test
entry.summary: Tres salidas del step `id: tests` terminan en `exit 0` sin haber ejecutado pytest: seleccion vacia, todos los paths de la seleccion inexistentes, y rc=5 (cero tests recogidos, el codigo documentado de pytest para esa condicion). Un renombrado de directorio de tests, o un shard cuyo path se vuelve obsoleto, produce un job verde indistinguible de un job que paso. Medido: los dos escenarios terminan con rc=0.
